SN1987A_transverse.high_coupling_allowed_boundary_body: e' > 1.5e-8 is allowed for m_gamma' < 2 m_e
SN1987A_transverse.high_coupling_allowed_boundary_conclusio: e' > 1.5e-8 is allowed for m_gamma' < 1 MeV
SN1987A_transverse.revision_scope: SN1987A transverse bound is revisited and stated to be one order of magnitude more stringent than the earlier derivation of Knapen et al.; no source authority here for superseding Hong Cas A.

SN1987A_longitudinal.role: excluded-band boundary semantics in product e' m_gamma'
SN1987A_longitudinal.low_coupling_allowed_boundary: e' m_gamma' < 7.4e-10 MeV for m_gamma' < 20 MeV
SN1987A_longitudinal.high_coupling_allowed_boundary_body: e' m_gamma' > 1.2e-5 MeV is allowed for m_gamma' < 2 m_e
SN1987A_longitudinal.high_coupling_allowed_boundary_conclusio: e' m_gamma' > 1.2e-5 MeV is allowed for m_gamma' < 1 MeV

NS1987A.mass_domain: m_gamma' <= T_NS1987A = O(10^9 K) = O(0.1 MeV)
NS1987A.lower_boundary: source explicitly states no lower bound from NS1987A
NS1987A.fiducial_envelope_parameter_context: eta = 1e-7 cooling curve; source notes eta >= 1e-8 is demanded for standard-cooling luminosity matching

guards: Do not promote O(0.1 MeV) to exact 0.1 MeV.
Do not interpret e'<1e-11 alone as excluding all larger couplings: the source explicitly has high-coupling allowed/trapping branches.
Do not blanket-supersede Hong Cas A or general young-NS branches.
Do not merge transverse and longitudinal relations into one boundary.
No raster/manual contour reading was used.
